body:
Scope correction (skills seat, 2026-09-19), on the maintainer's objection: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` records IMPLEMENTED, verified capabilities only (all 264 items are `status: active`; there is no planned state), so a checklist item cannot be the sole test — reading it that way closes every capability-gap card under the North Star's definition line, and 「缺任何一样就不是这个应用」 makes those gaps requirements, not expansion.

The test is two-layered and the `Path:` line carries both:
1. Definition layer first: which item of 「做出来的是什么」 does the card's capability fall under? None ⇒ outside the North Star ⇒ close.
2. Ledger layer second: an existing checklist item would FAIL ⇒ defect, inherit the item's P; no item exists ⇒ capability GAP ⇒ keep — on the path ⇒ P0/P1, off it ⇒ p3 (rule 2's 「p3 或不做」 resolves to p3 here) — and the gap is the input to `checklist-author` (write the item into the ledger before scheduling).

So :362 becomes `Path: <定义项> | <清单项 id | 缺项> | P<路步> | none`, and the one-line rule reads: 定义项落不到 ⇒ 关;有清单项会 fail ⇒ 继承其 P;缺项 ⇒ 缺口保留(路上 P0/P1,否则 p3)并列入待补账本;⛔「有人在等」不是判据. Acceptance greps updated accordingly: 「定义项」 and 「缺项」 in SKILL.md ≥ 1 each (control 0). Byte budget as before (812 / 812 line-neutral). Dispatch waits for the maintainer's sweep rounds to settle the wording.

**Triage: lane only — `domain:skills`. ⛔ Grading deliberately NOT applied.** Reading taken in THIS act, 2026-09-20T08:45Z. <sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

Landing point read from this card's own measured body, ⛔ not inferred from its title: it is governed surface / non-gate PM-loop tooling, which `SKILL.md` places in the skills row.

`finding` is applied and `priority:*` / `type` are left unset **on purpose** — the charter routes first-touch grading of this lane's findings to the skills seat itself (「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」). ⇒ this seat produces the lane, that seat produces the grade; `domain:skills` + `finding` is the defined waiting shape, ⛔ not a half-state.

### ⛔⛔ And this seat is one of the things this card is about — recorded, not deflected

This card's finding is that grading mapped cards onto a checklist **AREA** and read the hit as 「清单上的能力断了」. **This seat did exactly that, after the card was filed and while it sat ungraded.** On #19143 (graded this shift) the argument was: 「`dataset` IS a checklist capability — measured: dashboards 55 · studio-authoring 13 · platform-core 6 · records-forms 2 · api-backend 2, lit control flow 700 / view 608」. Every one of those is an **area-level word count**. ⛔ **No checklist ITEM covering runtime dataset creation was ever named.**

⇒ Under this card's correction that grade rests on an invalid step: the area hit is what lifted it out of 「不在清单上 ⇒ p3 或不做」. ⭐ The `p2` may still be right — the blast-radius discriminator against #19120 was independent of the checklist — but **the checklist half of its reasoning is withdrawn until an item id is named**, and a public note to that effect is going onto #19143 in this same act.

⚠️ For the skills seat grading this: the maintainer ruling quoted in this body — 「有人在等吗 是个伪命题」 — is the part with the widest reach, and this seat reads it as binding on its own take order too, ⛔ not merely on the sweep that produced the card.

- **Class (b)**: the charter's grading line contradicts the maintainer's ruling — re-read this act: `SKILL.md` :362 still reads 「正文首行 `Path: P<n> | <清单区> | none`」 (area, not item), and no line says 「有人在等」 is not a test. The filer's scope correction (5737998283) is the spec: a two-layer test — definition item first (none ⇒ close), then ledger item (an existing item would FAIL ⇒ inherit its P; no item ⇒ gap, on the path P0 / P1 else p3, listed for `checklist-author`) — carried by `Path: <定义项> | <清单项 id | 缺项> | P<路步> | none`.
- **Priority p2, not the filer's p1**: the live sweep the p1 named has run; what remains is that every first-touch grading in two repos reads a line that names the wrong test — this seat's own `Path:` lines this shift use the area shape. 「仪器为车队服务」: yes, every grader.
- **Serial**: #19340 is IN FLIGHT on the same `SKILL.md` filing / grading region (:342–:352, :371–:381, the six ruled items) — 同区域单跨轮硬串行 ⇒ this card dispatches after PR for #19340 reads MERGED by content; the two rulings then land as one coherent grading paragraph, not two edits to one line. Ceiling 813 / 813 ⇒ in place or by retirement, ≤ 120 B per line.
- The filer's own hold (「dispatch waits for the maintainer's sweep rounds to settle the wording」) is read as satisfied by the 2026-09-19 correction comment; the North Star text stays the maintainer's.
- `Path:` line prepended to the body (the card's `Path: none` becomes the seat's line).
